venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 7/25.** MOD MKZ/JK. Net $9,228 vs target $8,213 (+12.4%); food $490, comps $130. 291 guests, $31.71 check avg. MKZ opened, mid support at 6pm; very steady early evening, DJ at 9pm, strong $1,700 pop ~9:30. Great teamwork getting out from behind the bar and clearing glasses; mid cut ~1:30am. 86 High Noon and High Life. Favorite moment: meeting investor Jay Chai.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 7/25.** MOD KE/MD/JMS. Net $10,510 vs target $11,656 (-9.8%); food $431, comps $78.80 (0.75%). 396 guests, $26.54 check avg. Decent early game, dropped off 7:30-9 with another lull from 11 until a final push at 12:45. Birthdays in house; Lawson brought his Four Walls crew. JMS held the kitchen down. 86 NA beer. Favorite moment: a woman deadpanning 'Guinness' when asked about her super martini.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 7/25.** AM MOD Maggie & Maggie; PM Evan & Carey. Total net $24,171.03 vs target $16,688 (+44.8%), incl. events $24,446.05; D&C PM $22,405.07, DC/AM $1,765.96, Garden/6A $5,808.91, net event sales $1,294.81, food $3,951.95. 437 guests (Tock), comps $984.21 (4.03%). Busy, smooth & steady — UMS party again with guests in Vauxhall and the Garden while live music filled the outside air; Vauxhall a refuge from UMS and home for the D&C waitlist, much busier than last night with event classics and UMS-sponsored goodies. Only one VIP guest upset. Kitchen steady for Rand, Marvin, Nate; Chefs Josh and Rachel coasted through events. Favorite moment: 'All of it!' — UMS energy through the roof.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 7/25.** (Form said 'Friday 7/25' — matched by post time; 7/25 was Saturday.) MOD Kyler/Steves. Net $8,767 vs target $7,466 (+17.4%); beverage $7,812, food $903, retail $52; comps $236.54 (members, investors, gifts). 238 guests, $37 check avg. Great flow with heavy turns at 8 and 10pm; several birthdays including a high-energy 7-top. Waitlist finished past midnight, room half full at 1am, everyone out by 2:15. Sean & Thomas rocked heavy turns at the door; no no-shows. Top sellers: Rosalie, High Plains Drifter, Eight Limb Daiquiri / Native Lion (tie).

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 7/25.** MOD Gigi + Joe + Oscar + Saleh. Net $11,456 vs target $11,740 (-2.4%); Marquee $8,540, Standing Room $2,916; food $1,766; comps $684 (industry, birthdays, anniversaries, investors, service recovery). 323 guests. Very busy Saturday — room filled a little after 7pm just in time to open SR; Meech's last night brought a crowd. Both sides packed ~9pm with a decent waitlist, team burned and turned; both rooms full until 1am with a smooth last call. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: Bird bringing a case of pickle beer.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 7/25.** MOD Josh/Jesse. Net incl. events $9,165.20 vs target $8,660 (+5.8%); Marquee $8,026.20, Garden $1,139, food $725.20; comps $117.90 (1.28%), voids $99 (1.1%). 192 guests (72 resys / 120 walk-ins). Quick start then smooth, steady night that surpassed goal; room full ~9:30pm and again ~11pm, bar top mostly full through lulls. Garden slow-but-steady, beautiful after sundown, Jada solo with minimal support; last call there ~11pm to fill Marquee. Toast flag: rotating sour priced at $0; bar/floor have comp/void powers that should be reviewed. Maintenance: mice; bowed ceiling panel above service well. No-shows charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 7/25.** AM MOD Sam & Lex/Shannon; PM Braden & Marcus. Net $13,014 vs target $13,500 (-3.6%); Municipal AM $2,982, PM $7,195, Sun Club $1,235, Hot Eye $1,591; food $3,976; comps $248. Guests 322 (108 AM / 214 PM). Slow morning then strong lunch from 11am with large food tours and a photo shoot in the space. Moderate evening, family-heavy with lots of birthday sorbet; 5 servers to start, cuts at 8/9, last out at 11. Hot Eye had a long lull until 11:45 when a bigger-than-usual industry crew flipped the night. No lows or 86s.
